grasp_0.description: this grasp point is located on the handle of the spoon

plane_0.description: The plane is a horizontal plane defined by the rim of the spoon. Its centroid is located at the geometric center of the elliptical opening of the rim.

plane_1.description: The plane is a vertial plane for the front of the spoon. Its normal is aligned with the handle of the spoon, from the handle of the spoon to the head of the spoon.
